comment: Goblin's Dread, the goblin lair inside the Windspire: an instanced dungeon. Each party plays its own copy (crates/server/src/play/spaces.rs); a copy lives on for 30 minutes after the last player leaves it. Its portal stands on a ledge hidden behind the Windspire's waterfall (emberholm.json dungeons). Inside is a space of its own: everything is placed round its own origin, over nothing, and its boxes and decks are all that's solid there (src/engine/world/dungeons.ts, crates/engine/src/open/dungeon.rs). Boxes are solid below their top (floors and walls); decks are floors you can walk under. `arrive` is where you come in, `exit` the portal back out (F within r), `fall`: below it you are back at `arrive`. Heights (top) are above its origin. Map convention as Emberholm's: north is +Z, east is -X; facing 0 looks north.
name: Goblin's Dread
